headline: 6 lakh 22 thousand farmers in Maharashtra debt-free; 5,028 crore rupees deposited in loan accounts
summary: In the first phase of Maharashtra's farmer debt relief scheme, 622,000 eligible farmers became debt-free. Rs 5,028 crore was deposited in loan accounts.
why: Farm debt relief programmes affect rural credit conditions and the banks that lend to agriculture, and they can influence state fiscal spending.
